diagnosis: All four rollouts passed Content Check C1, which requires a general inactivity period of 90 days. Since the default value for `general_inactivity_days` is 90, the model consistently chose this value without needing the hidden information provided by PF1. This led to all checks related to PF1 (C2 and C7) failing, as the model did not have access to the necessary information.
